text: dsh-claude-compat 是面向 DSH Web 的 Claude Code 兼容插件，通过技能提供器、请求上下文贡献器、规则监听器和设置界面接入 Harness。它可加载 Claude 技能目录、CLAUDE.md 记忆及导入文件、自动记忆索引和路径匹配规则，并提供新增持久记忆的工具及五个独立开关。适合希望在 DSH 与 Claude Code 之间复用项目技能、提示文件和记忆的用户。无需额外 API 密钥；可配置 Claude 主目录。

dsh-claude-compat brings Claude Code resources into DSH Web. It loads Claude skills, CLAUDE.md memory, auto-memory, and path-scoped rules. It also offers a memory-writing tool and separate settings switches. Users can reuse project instructions across both tools without an API key.

让模型把新记忆保存成 Claude Code 可用的文件。
Load my existing Claude Code skills and instructions in DSH.
Can DSH apply path-specific Claude rules as I work?
I want to reuse Claude project memory without copying it.
dsh-claude-compat 的功能「Claude 技能加载」：在项目或用户的 .claude/skills 目录发现技能，并合并到 DSH 的技能目录；无需手工复制技能文件。
dsh-claude-compat 的功能「提示记忆注入」：请求处理时读取 CLAUDE.md、CLAUDE.local.md 及其 @path 导入内容，并按限制折入上下文。
dsh-claude-compat 的功能「路径规则应用」：读取 .claude/rules 下的规则；带 paths 的规则可在读取匹配文件后加入后续请求。
dsh-claude-compat 的功能「持久记忆写入」：模型调用 claude_memory_write 后，可新增主题记忆文件并更新 MEMORY.md 索引；不会覆盖已有主题。
dsh-claude-compat 的功能「兼容功能开关」：设置页提供技能、提示记忆、自动记忆、记忆写入和规则五个独立开关。

@guowenzhang/dsh-claude-compat README · Background：Many projects already maintain skills, rules, and memory around Claude Code. This plugin makes those existing projects compatible with DeepSeek Harness by reusing their resources and optionally writing new memories. You can use DSH alongside Claude Code while maintaining just one set of resources, without separate migration or duplication.

@guowenzhang/dsh-claude-compat README · Background：In the plugin list, display names and descriptions follow the Harness language setting in English or Chinese (English is the default fallback); English names use the package name without its npm scope, Chinese names describe the purpose, and installation still uses the unchanged real package name.

@guowenzhang/dsh-claude-compat README · Screenshot：**Settings → Claude compatibility**: five switches cover skill loading, memory loading, auto-memory loading, memory writing, and rule loading. Each switch has exactly one line, and that line states **the state the switch is in** — what it loads and its byte limits while it is on, what its off state does while it is off. Under it every entry lists its label, load paths, and a one-line hint, and one footer line states when a switch change takes effect.

@guowenzhang/dsh-claude-compat README · Install from npm：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @guowenzhang/dsh-claude-compat
```

Restart DSH after installation, then open **Settings → Claude compatibility**. Replace `web` with your profile name if you use another profile.

@guowenzhang/dsh-claude-compat README · Notes：- Skills, memory, auto-memory, and rule loading are enabled by default; memory writing is disabled by default. No switch depends on another: memory writing does not require any loading switch to be enabled first.
- A switch change applies to the **next request**: turning loading off does not take back what this session already folded, and a batch this session already folded is not folded again after turning a switch back on (memory and auto memory are separate paths, so the same holds for each). Start a new session after changing them.
- Writing only adds: a topic file is never overwritten, and `MEMORY.md` refuses new entries once it reaches 200 lines or 25 KB.
- Project and user `.claude` resources are reused. Memories are written only when the model calls the tool; existing memories are not automatically organized, overwritten, or deleted. When using Claude Code alongside DSH, avoid editing the same file simultaneously.
- Memory does not update live when files change; start a new session after changes. Nested memory and rules with `paths` load only after matching files are read, not when they are written or edited.
